browse.title: Genny
browse.subtitle: Network wishes — the organizations we hope will join us
browse.introTitle: What is Genny, and how does it work?
browse.intro: Genny is the network wish board. Organizations describe the kinds of institutions the network is missing and would benefit from — legal aid, health, printing, or transport. Each organization can endorse a wish once and remove its endorsement at any time. The Emtedad team starts with the most-endorsed wishes when nominating new organizations for Hakima membership.
browse.whyTitle: Why would this strengthen the network?
browse.supportersDescription: Names are intentionally hidden on the card so the endorsement stays focused on the idea, not who endorsed it.
browse.supportersDescriptionMine: Names are hidden on the card so endorsement stays focused on the idea, not who endorsed it.
browse.emptyDescription: Clear the filter or add a new wish.
browse.lockedNote: Editing and deletion close after the first endorsement — endorsement applies to the wording organizations saw. You can withdraw it instead.
browse.editableNote: Nobody has endorsed it yet — you can edit or delete it.
browse.newWishTitle: Have a wish that is not here?
browse.newWishDescription: Search first — if a similar wish exists, endorsing it is stronger than adding a duplicate.

legalAid.title: More legal-aid organizations
legalAid.description: The network needs organizations specializing in legal support for cultural workers — contracts, licenses, and intellectual property.
legalAid.why: Every organization handles contracts and licenses and currently pays outside the network. Two legal organizations would turn that into internal exchange.

communityHealth.title: Community health clinics
communityHealth.description: Clinics or health initiatives that can provide basic care to organization teams at network rates.
communityHealth.why: Most cultural workers have no health insurance. This would turn healthcare from a personal burden into a network resource.

printerPublisher.title: Printer and publishing house
printerPublisher.description: A small printer or independent publisher that can print catalogs, guides, and publications at network rates.
printerPublisher.why: Every organization prints, and printing is the third-largest expense for most of us. One printer inside the network would change everyone's budget.

transportLogistics.title: Transport and logistics service
transportLogistics.description: An organization or team specializing in moving equipment, sets, and publications between event venues.
transportLogistics.why: Transport recurs at every event and is currently arranged by chance or purchased outside the network at high cost.

culturalManagement.title: Cultural-management trainers
culturalManagement.description: Trainers specializing in cultural organization management — planning, budgeting, and fundraising.
culturalManagement.why: Most of our organizations were built through experience, not training. Trainers in the network would raise everyone's capacity.

rehearsalSpace.title: Shared rehearsal space
rehearsalSpace.description: A large, equipped rehearsal space that theatre, dance, and music groups can use in rotation.
rehearsalSpace.why: Many groups cancel rehearsals because they lack a venue. One shared space would serve at least six organizations.

personalLegalAdvice.title: Legal advice for individuals
personalLegalAdvice.description: Individual lawyers offering personal advice to team members on employment contracts and rights.
